messages:
kevin: deploybot auto-halted a rollout in us-west — orbit-service v2.3.1 canary failures (10% 503) :rotating_light:

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Release hold placed on orbit-service v2.3.1. Reason: canary error rate > threshold (10% over 5m). Remaining phases paused.

maria: thanks for the heads up. any stack traces/indicators?

oncall-sre-bot: @kevin assigned to oncall-sre. Collecting logs from canaries now.

oncall-sre-bot: suspect: kvcache eviction spike after kernel tweak from yesterday. grabbing pprof and kernel logs.

oliver: if it's kernel-related, we should pin traffic back to v2.3.0 on warm nodes and stop the rollout. Rolling forward risks broader impact.

trina: +1. Plan: pin to 2.3.0, cancel remaining canary phases, run backfill tomorrow low-traffic window. Also we should mark release notes as "paused" and note regression.

kevin: on it. I will update rollout config to pin to 2.3.0 and cancel pending slots. Command I'm running:

```
# pin replica set to previous image on warm pools
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/orbit-service orbit=registry/redwood/orbit:2.3.0 --record
# pause automated rollout
kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/orbit-service
```

kevin: done — pinned warm pools, paused rollout. :thumbsup:

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Manual action recorded: image rolled back on warm pools to orbit:2.3.0 by kevin. Rollout paused.

maria: can we also abort the canary job so it doesn't retry and hit the same nodes?

kevin: aborted pending canary jobs and removed scheduled retries.

oncall-sre-bot: I've pulled /var/log/kvcache and kernel dmesg from the affected host, sending to #eng-sre for deeper analysis. Early sign: OOM killer activity coincident with eviction spikes.

oliver: ok — can we contain blast radius: revert the kernel tweak on the affected node pool and cordon the hosts until SRE confirms?

trina: agree. SRE, please coordinate node rollback. Ops, prepare a backfill plan for 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC (low traffic).

oncall-sre-bot: cordon + kernel rollback scheduled for next 20m. Will post confirmation when complete.

kevin: updating release board: change window bumped. New backfill/resume window: 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC -> 05:00 UTC UTC. Owners: oliver (SRE), trina (releases), kevin (deploy).

maria: adding action items:
- SRE confirm kernel rollback and node health (+1hr soak)
- Regression test suite run against 2.3.1 on a sandbox cluster after kernel fix
- Update release notes: mark v2.3.1 paused due to kvcache regression
- Post-mortem if rollback/patch required

kevin: I'll also pin the release metadata in the console to prevent accidental re-promote.

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Hold still active. Next automated resume prevented until manual clear by release owner.

oliver: cordon + rollback finished, nodes are re-provisioning. Initial health checks look green. Will run soak for 60m then run regression tests.

trina: thanks. once SRE confirms soak, we'll decide whether to re-run canary with 2.3.1 or continue stay-on-2.3.0 and roll a patched build.

kevin: fyi, I've updated the changelog entry with the paused state and linked the incident ticket INC-2026-1123.

maria: :white_check_mark: sounds good. schedule update sent to stakeholders.

kevin: closing thread for now — will reopen if any requeue or rollback changes.

trina: leaving a reminder to restore automated retries after manual clear.

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Thread note: manual hold applied; owner kevin.
